title: AI makes in-game character creator in snowboard game
author: awallofburrito
selftext:
In the spirit of posting both wins and failures this demo contains both. I tested out my Agentic character creator SDK on claude having it make a snowboard game.

The demo is playable here: [https://smorchj.github.io/SNO/](https://smorchj.github.io/SNO/)

The wins:

The character creator was pretty much painless to implement in-game. The game snowboard mechanics are genuinely fun and with a better map and more detailed prompting and harnessing it could actually be the base of a good game

The failures:

The animations and the world building are the biggest outliers. This is another example that shows that agents have a hard time figuring this out themselves and proper tools and harnessing is needed.

Conclusion:

While AI is not going to make a game for you yet, game dev with AI is a matter of giving AI the puzzle pieces it needs to build the game. The character creator proves that. The [creategamecharacters.ai](http://creategamecharacters.ai/) SDK was the one thing that was properly made as a tool for agentic game dev work, was the one thing that worked well above all else. I guess the work is not over yet and there are still problems that I need to solve before I can talk a game into existence!

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body: nothing against this, It's cool, but just want to call out that if you're not doing the modelling yourself this is about a days work without AI in unity or godot.

replies.author: awallofburrito
replies.body: that is kind of what it is showing. The characters and the oneshot in-game character creator. Creating a full in-game character creator with a bunch of sliders and everything working blending between characters, with hair and outfits etc is not one days work in any engine without AI, I can tell you that from a lot of experience doing exactly that.
